sources.entry: micahkepe/vimtutor-sequel: Vimtutor Sequel - Advanced Vim Tutor Lessons

summary.one_liner: Vimtutor Sequel is a set of advanced Vim tutorial lessons meant to extend the basic vimtutor for users who want to deepen their Vim skills.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes the project as providing advanced Vim tutor lessons with advanced commands and techniques, step-by-step tutorials, and interactive exercises. It is installed via Homebrew (brew install vimtutor-sequel) or run by cloning the repository on Windows or Linux. The lessons are delivered as a Vim text file (vimtutor-sequel.txt) opened with a custom config file (vimtutor-sequel.vimrc). The README also mentions a --version flag available from version 1.2.3 onward and an upgrade path via brew upgrade. The README does not describe the specific lesson topics in detail.
use_cases: practicing Vim after the basic vimtutor
how_to_run: git clone the repository (URL not shown in README)
notable: Installs as a command via Homebrew, with a --version check from 1.2.3 onward
Runs without Homebrew by opening a copied lesson file with a custom vimrc
Lessons are plain text files opened inside Vim itself
caveats: Easiest install path is Homebrew, which is macOS/Linux-oriented; Windows and Linux users without Homebrew must clone and run manually
README does not detail specific lesson content or length
